# CalcSuite.in - Free Online Calculators

CalcSuite provides a comprehensive suite of free, fast, and mobile-friendly online calculators for financial, math, health, and India-specific needs.

## Core Calculator Sections

- Financial: Mortgage, Loan, Auto Loan, Investment, Retirement, Salary, Inflation, SIP.
- India Specific: GST (2025), EMI, Income Tax (FY 2025-26), FD, RD, PPF, HRA, Home Loan Eligibility.
- Health & Fitness: BMI, Calorie, Body Fat, BMR, Ideal Weight, Pregnancy, Ovulation.
- Math & Basic: Scientific, Triangle, Fraction, Percentage, Unit Converter.

## Authoritative Tools

1. GST Calculator India: https://calcsuite.in/calculator/india-gst/
2. Income Tax Calculator (FY 2025-26): https://calcsuite.in/calculator/india-tax/
3. EMI Calculator: https://calcsuite.in/calculator/india-emi/
4. SIP Calculator: https://calcsuite.in/calculator/sip/

## Embeddable Calculator Widget

CalcSuite offers a free calculator widget that any website can embed with one HTML snippet and one async script tag.

- Widget generator: https://calcsuite.in/widget-generator/
- Runtime script: https://calcsuite.in/widget.js
- Cost: free, no account, no API key, no usage limits.
- Licence condition: the credit link included in the snippet must stay visible and followable. The runtime restores it if removed, and the calculator does not load if it is blocked entirely.
- Isolation: renders in a Shadow DOM, so host page CSS and widget CSS cannot affect each other.
- Sizing: responsive from a 320px sidebar to a full-width article. A few calculators need 375px or 480px.
- Configuration: data-type, data-theme, data-font-size, data-padding, data-radius, data-border, data-shadow, data-max-width, data-branding.

- Sitemap: https://calcsuite.in/sitemap.xml
